The '''TIE Advanced x7''', also known as the '''TIE/Ad Defender''', '''defender starfighter''', '''TIE/x7''', or the '''TIE/Ad x7''', was a prototype [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. A highly-advanced starfighter, the TIE/Ad x7 was considered a radical departure from previous TIE designs in terms of appearance and performance. The fighter was only built as a prototype for the later [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] model on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], and featured three solar collectors evenly spaced around the cockpit pod, with triple arrays of maneuvering jets as well. The power boost allowed it to reach far greater speeds than standard TIE fighters, but the prototype lacked the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], missile launchers, and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that would make its way into the finalized TIE Defender.
